title: Fictional Scholarship Eligibility and Application Guide

pages.text: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Scholarships available in the simulated guide: Lakbay Academic Merit Award—term GPA 1.75 or better, at least 15 units, no failed courses; benefit 50% of tuition. Access Support Grant—GPA 2.50 or better, at least 12 units, fictional monthly household-income band at or below ₱30,000; benefit 35% of tuition. Community Service Award—GPA 2.50 or better, at least 12 units, 20 prior-term service hours; benefit 25% of tuition. Lower GPA numbers are stronger. Fictional examples.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Lakbay Academic Merit Award: Term GPA must not exceed 1.75 on this scale; carry at least 15 units and have no failed courses. The simulated benefit is 50% of tuition, excluding fixed charges. Renewal requires requalification each term. This example creates no actual award or entitlement.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Access Support Grant: Term GPA must not exceed 2.50; carry at least 12 units and meet the fictional monthly household-income band of ₱30,000 or below. Use a fictional income-band declaration in this exercise, never actual financial documents. The simulated benefit is 35% of tuition, excluding fixed charges; requalify each term.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Community Service Award: Term GPA must not exceed 2.50; carry at least 12 units and complete at least 20 service hours during the previous term. The simulated benefit is 25% of tuition, excluding fixed charges. Submit a fictional service log and requalify each term. This is not an actual scholarship entitlement.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Term A applications are due December 11, 2026, to the Scholarships Office. Use the mock scholarship application form, fictional grade summary, and fictional course plan; Access Support applicants add a fictional income-band declaration. The Scholarships Office reviews simulated applications. Benefits reduce tuition and exclude fixed charges; renewal requires requalification each term. These hypothetical programs do not create real applications, deadlines, awards, or entitlements and do not amend Document 101’s practice-form example.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Term A tuition is ₱1,000 per unit. Fixed charges: registration ₱700, library resources ₱500, technology ₱800, student services ₱1,000; total fixed charges ₱3,000. Worked example before scholarships: 18 units × ₱1,000 = ₱18,000 tuition; plus ₱3,000 fixed charges = ₱21,000 total. Scholarship benefits reduce tuition and exclude fixed charges.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Full payment is due January 22, 2027. The optional simulated plan lets learners pay tuition in three installments: 40% January 22, 30% February 19, and 30% March 19, calculated after any tuition award. For a ₱21,000 balance: ₱8,400, ₱6,300, and ₱6,300. A one-time ₱250 fee applies per missed installment after a five-calendar-day grace period; fees do not compound. Dropped units by January 15 receive tuition credit; fixed fees are non-refundable. Withdrawal January 16–February 12 refunds 50% of paid tuition; after February 12, no tuition refund.

title: Fictional Academic Policies and Student Handbook

pages.text: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Fictional grading: 1.00 is the highest numeric grade; lower numbers mean stronger performance. 3.00 is passing, 4.00 is conditional and non-passing, and 5.00 is failing. INC (incomplete) and W (withdrawn) are non-numeric. GPA is a unit-weighted average of numeric course grades. Scholarship GPA thresholds use this same scale.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Simulated enrollment procedure: select a sample program and courses, prepare a mock registration worksheet and fictional prior-course summary when prerequisite review is needed, obtain an adviser-reviewed course plan, submit it to the Registrar, and receive simulated confirmation. Advisers verify prerequisites before confirmation. Late registration January 11–12 requires Registrar approval and available seats; follow the January 11–15 calendar for add/drop. Document 103 states no real enrollment requirements apply. Never submit actual IDs or transcripts.

FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Attendance should be at least 80%; this expectation alone does not impose an automatic failing grade. Submit grade appeals to the Registrar within five working days after grade release. Academic concerns receive adviser review. Course changes follow the academic calendar and prerequisites must be verified before confirmation. Program completion requires 120 units and the program final project. These are fictional demonstration policies.
